## 1. Business Context & Scope

This database serves as the authoritative data source for Chinese A-share stock market information, encompassing corporate financials, equity structure, share transfers, dividend distributions, industry classifications, and stock archives. input.sql:
WITH 
-- 找出2019年符合条件的公司（去重）
qualified_companies AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.CompanyCode
    FROM lc_freefloat f
    WHERE strftime('%Y', f.ChangeDate) = '2019'
      AND f.AFloats >= 10000000000
),
-- 关联行业信息
company_industry AS (
    SELECT qc.CompanyCode, e.SecondIndustryName
    FROM qualified_companies qc
    LEFT JOIN lc_exgindustry e ON qc.CompanyCode = e.CompanyCode
)
-- 按二级行业分组计数
SELECT 
    COALESCE(ci.SecondIndustryName, '未分类') AS 二级行业,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ci.CompanyCode) AS 公司数量
FROM company_industry ci
GROUP BY ci.SecondIndustryName
ORDER BY 公司数量 DESC
